directionsTap: Pātōtia te pū tuatahi o tētahi kupu, kātahi ko tōna pū whakamutunga. Ka tauhia ngā kupu kua kitea i te mātiti, ā, ka whakawhitia i te rārangi.
directionsAcrossDown: Ka rere ngā kupu whakapae, whakararo rānei.
directionsDiagonal: Ka rere ngā kupu whakapae, whakararo, hauroki rānei.
directionsKeyboard: Mā te papapātuhi: neke ki ngā pātuhi pere, pēhia te Enter, te Space rānei i te pū tuatahi, ā, anō i te pū whakamutunga. Ka ūkuia e te Escape te pū tuatahi.
startAt: Tīmata i {letter}, rārangi {row} tīwae {column}. Ināianei kōwhiria te pū whakamutunga.
empty: Tāpirihia he kupu hei hanga panga.
unplaced: Kāore ēnei kupu e uru ki te mātiti, ā, kua waiho ki waho:
editing: Kua whakatāria te tākaro i a koe e whakatika ana.
